community_discord.note: The established local Pauper server (not run by DFW Pauper). When our own server is ready, swap name/url here.

_how_to_edit: Set url to the public website address. community_discord is the Discord we send new players to: change its name and url to switch servers. 'links' are DFW Pauper's own social profiles: paste each URL between the quotes, leave empty to hide. 'handle' is the @name shown for social posts (optional). The Discord entry here is for DFW Pauper's own server once it launches; until then it stays empty and community_discord is used.
